issues.description: Element: Animal.messageOnFeed() (abstract method). Problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares Animal.messageOnFeed() with '+' (public) and the tasks ask to define messageOnFeed() as abstract. The solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java) declares the method as protected: "protected abstract String messageOnFeed();". This visibility mismatch (public in the UML vs protected in the solution) can confuse students about the required method signature to implement/override and may lead to incorrect implementations or mismatches with automated tests that expect a public abstract method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either change the solution declaration to public: in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java replace the signature with "public abstract String messageOnFeed();", or update the problem statement/UML to show the method is protected and update the textual description accordingly. Prefer changing the solution to public if the UML and task text intend a public API.
